children: Journey reported Q3 2026 adjusted funds flow of $24.3M, up 19% from $20.5M a year earlier. It raised 2026 capital by $15M from August guidance, accelerating planned 2027 spending.
Q3 adjusted funds flow $24.3M, up 19% YoY
Funds flow improved despite sales volumes falling 19%; higher prices partly offset the volume decline.
2026 capital increased by $15M vs. August guidance
The increase accelerates previously planned 2027 spending, supporting earlier well completions and higher exit volumes.
Q3 net income $16.8M vs. $4.4M a year earlier
The increase includes $7.0M mark-to-market and $3.8M realized hedging losses; commodity prices also rose.
Q3 sales volumes fell 19% YoY to 9,559 boe/d
Asset dispositions reduced production, tempering the benefit of higher realized prices and improved product mix.
Lower debt supports liquidity as the company increases capital spending.

This is a mid-cycle update as Journey continues shifting its portfolio toward Duvernay light oil after asset sales. The next catalyst is delivery of the planned year-end wells and 2027 production growth, alongside updates to capital and production guidance.
